_note: Phase 3 gate holdout - OWNER TO AUTHOR. CI's final 'Verify Phase 3 gate holdout' step is RED by design until this is frozen (a green guard over an empty list is a false guarantee). Target: 48 questions = 24 EN/ES pairs. 12 pairs answerable + 12 pairs unanswerable => 24 answerable / 24 unanswerable, 24 EN / 24 ES. Each pair shares a 'pair_id'; both halves must agree on 'answerable'. NO reuse or trivial rephrase of eval_set v1.1.0 or regression_queries.json (the guard rejects normalized-text collisions; paraphrase review is manual). Per-question fields: id, pair_id, question, language ('en'|'es'), answerable (bool). Answerable also: expected_chunk_ids (non-empty; every id MUST exist in ingestion/output/chunks.jsonl - do NOT invent ids) + expected_answer. Unanswerable also: absence_note (a verifiable reason the corpus cannot answer it). When authored: set status to 'frozen', run `python -m src.features.evaluation.gate_holdout_integrity --write`, then `--verify`.
